title: basilicum polystachyon
intro: Basilicum polystachyon, commonly known as "Holy Basil" or "Tulsi", is a plant species native to India, widely used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, boost the immune system, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Basilicum polystachyon include its adaptogenic effects, antioxidant activity, and anti-cancer properties. Its bioactive constituents include volatile oils such as eugenol, rosmarinic acid, and ursolic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
